seo.title: Thank you | Intella Digital
seo.description: Thanks for contacting Intella Digital. Here is what happens next.

attrs.title: Thank you{name}. You’re in good hands.
attrs.lead: We’ve received your message. A senior member of our team will read it and reply within one business day, usually much sooner.

attrs.title: Here’s what to expect
attrs.lead: No long forms, no pushy sales calls. Just three simple steps.

items.title: We read your message
items.text: A senior member of the team reviews what you sent and replies with a few questions and times for a call.

items.title: Your free 30-minute call
items.text: We talk through your goals, look at your website and marketing together and share quick wins.

items.title: A clear proposal
items.text: You get a plan with scope, timeline and cost. No pressure, and no obligation to go ahead.

attrs.title: You’ve contacted the right team
attrs.lead: Growing businesses choose Intella Digital for marketing and development that work together, and for people who care about the results.

items.title: One team, both skills
items.text: Marketing and development under one roof, so nothing gets lost between suppliers.

items.title: Senior people on your account
items.text: You talk to the people who plan and do the work.

items.title: Reporting you can read
items.text: Clear monthly reports tied to enquiries, not vanity metrics.

items.title: You own everything
items.text: Your website, accounts, data and content stay in your name.

items.title: Ready for AI search
items.text: We plan for Google and for the AI assistants buyers now use.

items.title: Honest advice
items.text: If something isn’t right for you, we’ll tell you, even if it means less work for us.

cases.title: Cupello
cases.text: Modernising football coaching technology with a faster, more usable platform.

cases.title: The Other Glasses
cases.text: A luxury eyewear e-commerce experience, designed and built end to end.
